text_helper: Table 59. IWDG min/max timeout period at 40 kHz (LSI) — section 6.3.16 Timer characteristics. Prescaler divider, PR[2:0] bits, Min timeout (ms) RL[11:0]= 0x000, Max timeout (ms) RL[11:0]= 0xFFF.

notes: 1. These timings are given for a 40 kHz clock but the microcontroller’s internal RC frequency can vary from 30 to 60 kHz. Moreover, given an exact RC oscillator frequency, the exact timings still depend on the phasing
